items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Crawford was the leader. Crawford played first drums in the band, and Mose played second fiddle.

ctx.x: And the way he'd hit the note, you know. Like, a lot of guys pick it like this? He used to hit those notes. Big, like that. That was the style then, and Mose Allen wasn't a great bass player, but he used that style and -- he didn't play many notes, though.
Well, he sort of -- he slapped more.
